takeaway: By default a Java 23 Swing client and a MySQL server (127.0.0.1:3306, schema reports_db) run on the same workstation; the JVM talks JDBC/TCP 3306 using Hibernate, the MySQL driver and the persistence.xml deployment spec.

elements.name: User workstation
elements.responsibility: Desktop machine; by default also hosts MySQL (JDBC URL 127.0.0.1)

elements.name: JVM (Java 23) Swing desktop client
elements.responsibility: Runs the GUI, controllers, entities and JPA code in one process

elements.name: META-INF/persistence.xml (deploymentSpec)
elements.responsibility: Classpath deployment spec: JDBC URL, user, password, hbm2ddl=update, show_sql=true; edit to change the database

elements.name: forms_rt 7.0.3
elements.responsibility: GUI Designer runtime for .form bound panels

elements.name: MySQL server 127.0.0.1:3306
elements.responsibility: Stores all data; same host by default, remote needs new URL and grant

elements.name: schema reports_db (user reports_user@localhost)
elements.responsibility: Database created manually; tables managed by Hibernate
